changelog:
• Floating editor panels now use edge-aware controls: minimize/maximize and resize automatically switch to the opposite side when a panel is moved near the left or right edge, so the panel can stay flush with the screen without wasting space. The side is restored automatically from the saved panel position.
• Audio Studio cleanup: duplicate Undo and Redo buttons were removed from Audio Tools because the main toolbar already provides them.
• Export Audio now behaves like a switch: pressing it again closes the export panel.
• The Remove Edge Silence action now has a clearer icon.
• Clip-edge magnetic snapping can be enabled or disabled from View while Audio Studio is active, using the same saved Auto-connect nearby clips setting as the timeline control.
• Workshop + IniHub tracked-item update detection and the IDE application update checker remain integrated.
